title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Auction of Arrested Ships by Maritime Courts to Satisfy Debts

articles.content_en:
III. Debt Repayment
(1) After the expiration of the claim registration period, the maritime court shall convene a creditors' meeting. All creditors shall, through negotiation, propose a distribution plan in accordance with the order of repayment, sign a repayment agreement, which shall be confirmed by a ruling of the maritime court. If negotiation fails, the maritime court shall make a ruling;
(2) The proceeds from the auction of the ship and the interest thereon shall be distributed together;
(3) Order of repayment:
Repayment shall be made in accordance with Articles 21, 22, 23, 24 and 25 of the Maritime Code of the People's Republic of China.
The repayment of other registered claims shall be after the order set forth in the preceding paragraph.
Before repayment in the above order, the litigation costs, the expenses incurred for preserving, auctioning the ship and distributing the proceeds thereof, and other expenses paid for the common benefit of the maritime claimants shall be paid with priority from the proceeds of the ship auction.
(4) The balance after repayment of debts shall be returned to the original shipowner. IV. If a maritime court auctions a detained ship to repay debts during the enforcement proceedings, it may handle the matter by reference to the above relevant provisions.

V. These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. The Specific Provisions on the Compulsory Sale of Detained Ships to Repay Debts issued by this Court on August 29, 1987 shall be abolished simultaneously.
July 6, 1994
